requestedText: Add a provider-agnostic Weekly Radar Telegram publisher adapter that forwards complete semantic chunks through an injected transport.

evidence: The adapter receives an injected transport and immutable in-memory chunks; it does not load files, invoke network clients, or resolve runtime providers.
No external consumer exists in this repository beyond the module-local and public integration tests; provider-side publication is explicitly out of scope.
The adapter has no telemetry, monitoring, receipt, retry, scheduler, polling, or webhook behavior.
The Contract authorizes the full repository lifecycle while restricting this implementation to the injected infrastructure adapter and tests.
